Subject: Hypersegmented RSVP journey + click matrix for June 28 webinar

Team — putting a first draft on the table for the June 28 "Scaling LLM Inference" webinar. Goal: high-quality engineering attendance + a healthy mix of platform / infra decision-makers. I attached an initial segmentation + cadence workbook (hyperseg_rsvp_map_v1.xlsx).

Key asks: please review copy owners, tracking UTM strategy, and the target-list owners column. I propose we run hypersegmentation across these audience buckets:
- Core engineers (APIs, embeddings) — narrow send, friendly tone
- Platform/infra leads — emphasize SLAs, cost controls
- Security/compliance personas — highlight SOC2/data handling content
- Field/Prospects (post-demo interest) — broader reach, partner co-host mentions

Tentative cadence (per segment):
1) Invite: 7/14 (save-the-date + registration)
2) Reminder A: 7/21 (value bullets + speakers)
3) Reminder B: 7/25 (24h)
4) Last chance: day-of + calendar invite
5) Post-webinar follow-up with recording + CTA

Tracking plan (high level): utm_source=email, utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=jun28_scaling, utm_content={segment}_{variant}. Full UTM matrix in utm_matrix_v2.csv.

Owners: Marissa — subject lines & invitation copy. Karthik — tracking/HubSpot mapping and audience export. I'll coordinate partner assets (Acme Cloud) and scheduling.

Attached: hyperseg_rsvp_map_v1.xlsx

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz

vanessa@redwood.com

Nice starter — thanks, Vanessa. Quick thoughts: 
- Two subject-line variants I like for A/B: 
  A) "Scaling LLM inference: engineering patterns that cut latency & cost"
  B) "How companies cut 2x inference cost without accuracy loss — Jun 28"
- For core engineers: keep copy < 120 words, include a 2-line technical teaser (kernel optimizations + batching), link to a short snippet blog post.
- For platform leads: include an early bullet on SLA/throughput (we should call out example throughput numbers if available).

On cadence: can we shift invite to 7/14? Vanessa suggested 7/14 already — good. For the platform bucket, let's add a canary send to 200 users 48 hours before full send to check deliverability.

UTM note: prefer utm_content values like "eng_ab1" vs descriptive long names — keeps URLs shorter for tracking. I'll take subject lines and the core engineer copy.

—Marissa
